trail.planningNote: Access restriction reviewed September 5, 2026: NPS reports the old Death Canyon road and trailhead closed, including to pedestrians. These published distances use that old start; do not use them for an alternate trailhead or the future relocated start. Check NPS construction updates before planning. Long, steep mountain hike: check current conditions with a backcountry ranger. Snow travel may require specialist skills and equipment. The trailhead-area forecast does not represent the higher route. TrailPack covers day-hike packing, not climbing or overnight equipment.
